Settings

Needs the Places API (New) enabled. Stored here, never in the CMS.

Usage

Drop the Google Reviews component on a page, or add to a template:
{{ google_reviews("PLACE_ID", 5) }} for the block, {{ reviews_aggregate_rating("PLACE_ID") }} for rich-result markup.
